mapper.select: select id, pool_name, merchant_member_id, entry_node_id, topic_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_time from node_task_pool where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, pool_name, merchant_member_id, entry_node_id, topic_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_time from node_task_pool where status = 1 and ( (#{entryNodeId} is not null and entry_node_id = #{entryNodeId}) or (#{merchantMemberId} is not null and merchant_member_id = #{merchantMemberId}) or (#{topicId} is not null and entry_node_id is null and merchant_member_id is null and topic_id = #{topicId}) ) order by case when #{entryNodeId} is not null and entry_node_id = #{entryNodeId} then 1 when #{merchantMemberId} is not null and merchant_member_id = #{merchantMemberId} then 2 else 3 end, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into node_task_pool (pool_name, merchant_member_id, entry_node_id, topic_id, status, create_by) values (#{poolName}, #{merchantMemberId}, #{entryNodeId}, #{topicId}, #{status}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: select i.id, i.pool_id, i.node_id, i.weight, i.status, i.create_time, n.name as node_name from node_task_pool_item i left join cms_topic_node n on n.id = i.node_id where i.pool_id = #{poolId} order by i.id asc

select i.id, i.pool_id, i.node_id, i.weight, i.status, i.create_time, n.name as node_name from node_task_pool_item i left join cms_topic_node n on n.id = i.node_id where i.pool_id = #{poolId} and i.status = 1 and i.weight > 0 order by i.id asc
select i.id, i.pool_id, i.node_id, i.weight, i.status, i.create_time, n.name as node_name from node_task_pool_item i left join cms_topic_node n on n.id = i.node_id where i.id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into node_task_pool_item (pool_id, node_id, weight, status) values (#{poolId}, #{nodeId}, #{weight}, #{status})
insert into node_task_dispatch (member_id, pool_id, dispatch_date, node_id, random_receipt_id) values (#{memberId}, #{poolId}, #{dispatchDate}, #{nodeId}, #{randomReceiptId})
